headline: A big gain for the Colts
what_happened: D.Jones threw a short pass to J.Downs, and because of a penalty on J.Hicks for roughing the passer, the Colts earned a fresh set of downs closer to the goal.
who: D.Jones, J.Downs, L.Sneed, and J.Hicks were involved in this play.
why_it_matters: This is bad news for the Chiefs because it gives the Colts a much better chance to score. The Colts increased their win probability by 7 percentage points after this successful drive.
